title: "Gants named interim Sheriff" (Drew Lawson, Jun 13, 2022)
notes: Public preview: Sgt. Gabe Gants, 18 years with LCSO, named interim sheriff effective July 1, 2022 after Sheriff Wade Magers' retirement; chosen from three finalists named by the Lincoln County Republican Central Committee.
